title: Resonate
summary: New commissions from Resonate, Play Office's artist development programme, shown continuously throughout Memory Library.

title: Film Programme
summary: A continuous programme of moving-image work, showing throughout the day in the Cinema.

title: Queer at Sea
summary: An exhibition exploring queerness, coastal space and belonging, shown throughout the daily programme.
blurb: Exhibition on queerness and coastal life.
body: Queer at Sea runs throughout Memory Library's daily programme, part of the ongoing exhibition in the Main Space.

title: Memory Bar
summary: A sensory artwork using taste, smell, storytelling and participation to explore memory.
blurb: A sensory artwork using taste, smell, storytelling and participation to explore memory.
body: Memory Bar returns as part of Memory Library, creating an intimate participatory space where sensory experiences, drinks and stories become prompts for remembering and sharing personal histories.

title: Empathy Index
summary: A digital commission exploring empathy, connection and the ways technology can make relationships between people visible.
blurb: A digital commission exploring empathy, connection and the ways technology can make relationships between people visible.
body: Empathy Index is being developed as a digital artwork within the wider Memory Library programme, using creative technology to explore connection, social relationships and empathy.

title: International Open Studio
summary: An open studio bringing together visiting artists from international exchange programmes with Portsmouth audiences and artists.
blurb: An open studio bringing together visiting artists from international exchange programmes with Portsmouth audiences and artists.
body: International Open Studio presents work, process and research by visiting artists from Bangladesh, Cairo and Lebanon through informal showings and public exchange, connecting international practices with Portsmouth's cultural community.

title: Memory Donation
summary: A participatory project inviting people to contribute memories to the evolving Memory Library archive.
blurb: A participatory project inviting people to contribute memories to the evolving Memory Library archive.
body: Memory Donation creates a route for audiences and communities to contribute their own memories, stories and fragments to Memory Library, treating participation itself as part of the artwork and archive.

title: Memory Box
summary: An interactive installation exploring how memories can be collected, held, encountered and shared.
blurb: An interactive installation exploring how memories can be collected, held, encountered and shared.
body: Memory Box forms part of Memory Library's wider exploration of personal archives and shared memory, using an installation format to turn acts of remembering and collecting into a public experience.

title: Past Makes Future
summary: A one-day conference and gathering bringing together international delegates, artists and heritage partners.

title: Bangladesh — Artist Presentation
summary: A presentation from Zihan Karim and Shohrab Jahan, part of Past Makes Future.

title: Cairo — Artist Presentation
summary: A presentation from Raneem Elhaddad and Ahmed Nader, part of Past Makes Future.

title: Portsmouth as an Engine for Creativity
summary: A panel with Gemma Nichols, Steve Pitt, Arts Council England and University of Portsmouth, on sector value and infrastructure.

title: Pageant
summary: An evening performance closing Past Makes Future. Doors 19:30, performance from 20:00.

title: People Library
summary: People, not books, as a browsable living collection. Drop in and borrow a person for twenty minutes.
blurb: Borrow a person, not a book.
body: People Library is a participatory Memory Library project centred on personal and community memories. Audiences can meet and borrow a person for a conversation, turning lived experience into a shared, temporary archive.

title: Bangladesh Workshop
summary: A workshop connected to Bangladesh, part of Memory Library's international exchange.

title: Bangladesh Screening
summary: A screening connected to Bangladesh, part of Memory Library's international exchange.

title: Egypt Workshop
summary: A workshop connected to Egypt, part of Memory Library's international exchange.

title: Lebanon Workshop
summary: A workshop connected to Lebanon, part of Memory Library's international exchange.

title: We Shine
summary: Boathouse 5 stays open into the evening as part of We Shine, with the exhibition continuing and the exterior projection running after dark.
